messages:
owen: Heads up — prod-usw2 GPU allocator pool failing to join after the authz TTL tweak. Nodes showing PendingJoin. :eyes:  

kayla: saw this, allocator-controller logs show grant / STS errors. can you paste a snippet?

owen: logs:
ERROR allocator-controller keystore.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: KMS grant expired
status code: 403, request id: a1b2c3d4
time="2026-03-18T14:02:10Z" level=error msg="session token invalid: STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity session expired"

jess: kubectl shows many NotReady nodes and repeated join retries. allocator is failing during decrypt of disk secrets.

kayla: any firewall/VPC changes that might block STS or KMS?

owen: no firewall changes. security rolled an IAM session-duration policy at 2026-03-18T13:00 reducing ephemeral role TTL to 1h. allocator expected longer lived grants.

samantha: confirmed I applied the TTL change. thought existing sessions would be ok but allocator's refresh flow can't renew under the new evaluator.

jess: result: allocator's keystore refresh gets AccessDenied and node bootstrap halts.

ci-bot: Deploy 2026-03-18T13:05: keystore/role-ttl-change applied by samantha.

kayla: mitigation options: rollback TTL, allowlist allocator assume-role, or restart allocator controllers. least risk: scoped allowlist for allocator role.

owen: prefer allowlist, then fix allocator refresh path. I'll open PR to authz service.

jess: restart allocator-controller after patch so they reattempt join. kayla can you run restart?

kayla: applying patch and restart now. patch: kubectl -n infra patch configmap authz-exceptions -p '{"data":{"allocator-assume":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/allocator-prod-usw2"}}' then scale deploy to 0/3.

ci-bot: Change request CR-4981 created by owen: authz allowlist for allocator role in prod-usw2.

samantha: patched and added audit note. keeping TTL change paused.

kayla: allocator-controller pods restarted. seeing join events: 8 nodes Registered so far.

owen: decrypt errors dropped from ~180 to 3.

jess: add dashboard panels for gpu_pool_join_rate and keystore_decrypt_errors while we monitor.

samantha: plan: keep allowlist 24h, ticket allocator to support short TTLs, schedule compliance review for acceptable durations. I'll own allowlist and review.

owen: filing allocator ticket and drafting design doc for refresh vs long sessions.

kayla: monitoring — PendingJoin nodes are flipping to Ready. will watch for 60m and report. :thumbsup:

jess: add runbook note: authz TTL rollouts must coordinate with allocator refresh semantics.

samantha: will add a preflight check to policy rollout checklist to query allocator sessions and kube join windows.

ci-bot: Incident partially resolved at 2026-03-18T14:06:40 — auto-note added.
